stem: Which of these statements best summarizes the section titled “Stretching into Success”?

options.label: F
options.text: When Peter Hodgson purchased the rights to make the putty, he decided to call it Silly Putty.

options.label: G
options.text: Peter Hodgson learned of an invention, named it Silly Putty, and used his experience to successfully advertise it.

options.label: H
options.text: Peter Hodgson realized that children around the country would like the putty if he came up with a good name for it.

options.label: J
options.text: To help make James Wright’s invention popular, Peter Hodgson wanted to give more people the opportunity to know about it.
